display.purpose: The single largest headline on a page (landing hero, gate 'Sign in to continue'). Never used for body copy, labels, or buttons.

ui.purpose: Default voice for nav, buttons, panel headings, field labels, status badges, feed/log lines, tabs. Uppercase, wide tracking.

body.purpose: Landing hero subcopy and any long-form paragraph text only.

scale.purpose: 0.62-0.9rem organic step scale for labels/captions/badges/timestamps at varying densities across landing, gate, and dashboard; see DESIGN.md Typography section for the full step list.

shadows.name: landing-button-glow
shadows.purpose: Offset+blur resting/hover shadow on the primary landing button - revised from a zero-offset inset halo the design detector flagged as a generic AI-glow tell.

shadows.name: landing-button-pulse
shadows.value: 1px solid #ffc700 ring, 0->0.7->0 opacity, scale 0.97->1.14, 1.1s, fires once ~0.6s after mount
shadows.purpose: The single authored 'verification flash' moment on the primary CTA, replacing the old always-on glow.

shadows.name: tracker-current-halo
shadows.purpose: Soft ring around the status tracker's current (in-progress) step.

shadows.name: pill-dot-glow
shadows.purpose: Glow on the small status dot inside the landing pill badge.

shadows.name: vault-ambient-glow
shadows.value: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, gold 8%, transparent 70%) behind the vault-frame canvas
shadows.purpose: Faint ambient warmth behind the dashboard Vault widget; not a box-shadow.

motion.name: hover-scale-liquid
motion.purpose: LiquidButton hover growth, dashboard primary actions.

motion.name: color-transition
motion.purpose: Default transition speed for color/border state changes across the system.

motion.name: gate-stamp-in
motion.purpose: Wallet-gate 'access granted' stamp - deliberately uses overshoot/bounce easing to read as a physical stamp settling onto paper; a reviewed exception to the system's default exponential easing, confirmed literal/domain-appropriate rather than decorative.

motion.name: vault-status-ease
motion.value: continuous per-frame lerp toward status-derived targets (shell scale/opacity, ring opacity, orb scale/position/color), ~0.35s time constant, 0.05s when prefers-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: The dashboard Vault's entire animation system - a pure function of the selected bounty's on-chain status, never a timed/phased sequence, so it can't drift from the real contract state.

components.name: Landing Button
components.description: Primary CTA on landing and header ([Launch App] -> /connect). Cut corners, gold border, offset+blur resting shadow, a single verification-pulse ring on mount, diagonal accent lines at two clipped corners.
components.css: .ds-btn-landing { position: relative; height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; background: #000000; border: 1px solid #ffc700; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 28px -10px #ffc700; transition: box-shadow 300ms ease-out; clip-path: polygon(16px 0, calc(100% - 16px) 0, 100% 16px, 100% calc(100% - 16px), calc(100% - 16px) 100%, 16px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 16px), 0 16px); } .ds-btn-landing:hover { box-shadow: 0 10px 36px -6px #ffc700; } .ds-btn-landing:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffc700; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Liquid Button
components.description: Dashboard's primary action button (Create Bounty, Claim, Release, Refund, Rate). Transparent fill, gold text, glass-refraction hover treatment.
components.css: .ds-btn-liquid { height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 4px; color: #ffc700; font-family: 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.03), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 0 12px rgba(255,255,255,0.15); transition: transform 300ms, box-shadow 300ms; } .ds-btn-liquid:hover { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-btn-liquid:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffc700; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-liquid:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Dashboard Panel
components.description: Standard dashboard container with gold bracket-corner marks and a mono uppercase heading. The same bracket language now also appears on the landing Verification Panel, the wallet-gate Access Ledger, and the dashboard Vault frame.
components.html:

Panel content goes here.
components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; background: #111111; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 4px; padding: 20px 22px; } .ds-panel::before, .ds-panel::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 10px; height: 10px; pointer-events: none; } .ds-panel::before { top: -1px; left: -1px; border-top: 1px solid #ffc700; border-left: 1px solid #ffc700; } .ds-panel::after { bottom: -1px; right: -1px; border-bottom: 1px solid #ffc700; border-right: 1px solid #ffc700; } .ds-panel-heading { font-family: 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; margin: 0 0 14px; color: #a3a3a3; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Fixed four-state pill (Open/Claimed/Released/Refunded) mapped to semantic colors, used on bounty rows and detail panels.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-badge-open { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12); color: #f59e0b; } .ds-badge-claimed { background: rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.12); color: #60a5fa; } .ds-badge-released { background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.12); color: #22c55e; } .ds-badge-refunded { background: rgba(163, 163, 163, 0.12); color: #a3a3a3; }

components.name: Landing Pill
components.description: Status/context badge on the landing hero (e.g. "BOT CHAIN TESTNET") - cut corners, backdrop blur, glowing gold dot.
components.css: .ds-pill { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; background: rgba(38, 38, 38, 0.5); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); border: 1px solid #424242; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); font-family: 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; clip-path: polygon(6px 0, calc(100% - 6px) 0, 100% 6px, 100% calc(100% - 6px), calc(100% - 6px) 100%, 6px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 6px), 0 6px); } .ds-pill-dot { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ffc700; margin-right: 8px; box-shadow: 0 0 8px 2px #ffc700; }

components.name: Verification Panel
components.description: Landing-hero readout proving the product's claims (real contract address linked to explorer, verified badge, live bounty count over read-only RPC) instead of asserting them. Bracket corners, semi-transparent dark ground.
components.html: Contract0x956E...5Cc1
components.css: .ds-verify-panel { position: relative; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); border: 1px solid #424242; padding: 14px 18px; font-family: 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; } .ds-verify-bracket { position: absolute; width: 12px; height: 12px; } .ds-verify-bracket-tl { top: -1px; left: -1px; border-top: 1px solid #ffc700; border-left: 1px solid #ffc700; } .ds-verify-bracket-br { bottom: -1px; right: -1px; border-bottom: 1px solid #ffc700; border-right: 1px solid #ffc700; } .ds-verify-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }

components.name: Dashboard Tabs
components.description: Underline-style tab bar splitting the dashboard into Bounties/Create/Activity. Mono uppercase, 1px bottom rule, gold underline + gold text on the active tab; introduced in the stage-3 onboarding restructure to replace a single stacked 7-panel page.
components.css: .ds-tabs-list { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a2a2a; } .ds-tabs-trigger { font-family: 'Geist Mono Variable', monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #a3a3a3; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem; margin-bottom: -1px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-tabs-trigger:hover { color: #ffffff; } .ds-tabs-trigger-active { color: #ffc700; border-bottom-color: #ffc700; }

components.name: Status Banner
components.description: Wallet/network status strip above the dashboard tabs. State signaled by a small colored dot before the message plus a subtly state-tinted 1px border - revised from a 3px colored border-left, which the design detector correctly flagged as a generic AI-UI tell ("side-tab").
components.css: .ds-banner { position: relative; background: #111111; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-size: 0.9rem; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-banner-msg { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-banner-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #a3a3a3; } .ds-banner-good { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, #22c55e 40%, #2a2a2a); } .ds-banner-good .ds-banner-dot { background: #22c55e; }

narrative.overview:
Agent Escrow reads as a monitored, high-stakes instrument across all three surfaces - Persuade (landing), the wallet-connect gate, and Operate (dashboard) - closer to a trading floor or mission-control console than a consumer crypto app. Void-black surfaces, a single gold signal accent, and monospace type carry every screen. The landing hero now proves its claims with a live Verification Panel (real contract address, verified badge, a live on-chain bounty count) instead of resting on mood alone; the wallet gate frames connecting a wallet as a 'Signature Ritual' - a ledger the visitor signs into, ending in a notary-stamp moment; the dashboard splits what was a single stacked seven-panel page into three tabs (Bounties/Create/Activity) fronted by a live 3D Vault that acts out the selected bounty's real on-chain status (sealed when Open, a scanning ring while Claimed, opening and releasing a glowing orb on Released, sealing red on Refunded) rather than illustrating it abstractly.

This is no longer a before-snapshot. The system was deliberately amplified, not replaced: every new surface (gate, tabs, Vault) inherits the same tokens, the same bracket-corner language, the same mono-first type system, and the same restrained gold-only palette established in the original build - proven out across a full critique-driven landing redesign, a new wallet-gate surface, an onboarding restructure, and a 'no limits' creative pass, with each stage's detector findings reviewed and either fixed (the zero-offset button glow, the 3px side-bar banners) or deliberately kept (the gate stamp's overshoot easing, as literal stamp physics).
keyCharacteristics: One accent color (gold, #ffc700) against near-total black-and-white; no secondary or tertiary hue in use, even across three new surfaces.

Corners are either cut (clip-path polygon, landing/button surfaces) or bracketed (gold L-shaped corner marks) - now shared across the dashboard panel, landing verification panel, gate ledger, and dashboard vault frame.
Monospace is the dominant UI voice at a real organic micro-scale (0.62-0.9rem); a light-weight serif-adjacent display face (Sentient) is reserved for large hero/page-title moments only.

Depth comes from offset+blur accent glow (never zero-offset) and bracket marks, not shadow elevation - flat at rest, with exactly one authored motion moment per surface rather than ambient decoration.
The dashboard is deliberately narrow (max 640px), now organized into three tabs instead of one long stack, with wallet/network status and the tx log as persistent chrome rather than tabs themselves.
State is proven, not decorated: the landing panel reads the real chain, the dashboard Vault is a pure function of real bounty status - nothing animates a claim the product can't back.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only hue in the system. It never gets a second saturated color to share the stage with; new UI reaches for gray-scale or the fixed semantic status set before introducing another accent.

rules.name: The Mono-First Rule
rules.body: Default to Geist Mono for any new interface text. Sentient is earned only by the single largest headline on a page - it is never used for body copy, labels, or buttons.

rules.name: The Cut-or-Bracket Rule
rules.body: A primary interactive surface earns a signature corner treatment (clip-path cut or bracket marks) rather than a plain rounded rectangle. Secondary/utility elements (inputs, tags, generic shadcn buttons) may use plain border-radius.

rules.name: The Offset Glow Rule
rules.body: Any glow shadow carries an offset and a blur radius (e.g. 0 8px 28px -10px); a zero-offset colored halo reads as decoration, not craft, and is the specific pattern this system's detector flags as a generic AI-design tell.

dos: Do keep gold (#ffc700) as the system's only accent color; reach for the fixed semantic status set (info/good/warn/bad) before introducing a second brand hue.
Do default new UI text to Geist Mono, uppercase, wide tracking; reserve Sentient strictly for the single largest headline on a page.
Do give primary interactive surfaces a signature corner treatment (clip-path cut or bracket marks) rather than a plain rounded rectangle.
Do keep the dashboard a narrow, single-column console (640px cap), organized into tabs with wallet/network/tx-log status as persistent chrome, not additional tabs.
Do let new UI prove product claims with real data (contract reads, live status) before reaching for decorative motion or copy that only asserts them.
donts: Don't introduce box-shadow-based elevation layering or zero-offset glow halos; this system signals depth with offset+blur accent glow and bracket marks, not shadow stacks or decorative halos.
Don't add a colored border-left/border-right thicker than 1px on any card, banner, or callout - use a status dot plus a subtly tinted 1px border instead.

Don't duplicate the button implementations (LandingButton, LiquidButton, base Button) without reason - each is scoped to a specific surface; a fourth ad hoc button style is a regression, not a new pattern.
Don't animate a state the contract doesn't actually report - the Vault, trackers, and status badges are all pure functions of real on-chain data, never a timed or optimistic guess.
